verdict.rationale: A recorded runtime probe shows the documented `npx -y skills add ... -y --copy` command completing a real, non-interactive, promptless install of a skill into a scratch project end-to-end, matching the README's claims (mattpocock-skills-probe-rt-1), and docs confirm the update/copy mechanics support headless automation (mattpocock-skills-docs-4, mattpocock-skills-docs-24, mattpocock-skills-docs-31). Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) confirmation of the alternate `claude plugins install mattpocock-skills` marketplace path being equally non-interactive, and testing across multiple skills/agents beyond the single tdd example.
